databases.name: firstmate
databases.retention: Keep mirrored firstmate-home documents until the operator uninstalls the plugin or deletes firstmate.db. Uninstall archives the database because it holds operator-owned fleet records. The plugin never prunes another plugin's history.

databases.description: Versioned mirror of a firstmate home's markdown inventory: startup working set, archives, task state, one-shot operational docs, and per-task artifacts. Every rewrite is a new row; the current file is the latest version.
questions: What did the firstmate home mirror record?
Which firstmate working-set files, archives, task state, operational docs, or per-task artifacts were mirrored?

tables.name: homes
tables.description: Firstmate homes whose markdown inventory is mirrored into this database.

tables.name: tasks
tables.description: Task identities kept for cross-references. The backlog query layer stays in tasks-axi; this table does not replace it.
questions: Which task ids are mirrored for cross-references?

tables.name: working_set_versions
tables.description: Versioned startup working set: captain.md, captain-shared.md, learnings.md, projects.md, and secondmates.md. Each rewrite is a new row; is_current marks the latest file.
questions: What is in the firstmate startup working set?
Which versions of captain.md were mirrored?

tables.name: archive_versions
tables.description: Versioned stow archives: captain-archive.md, memory-archive.md, and note-archive.md.

tables.name: task_state_versions
tables.description: Versioned backlog.md and done-archive.md, mirrored for cross-references only.
questions: Which backlog or done-archive versions are mirrored?

tables.name: operational_doc_versions
tables.description: Versioned one-shot dated operational docs at the data root. document_kind is the filename prefix (decision, order, brief, status, planning, handover, postmortem, and later prefixes).
questions: Which one-shot firstmate operational docs were mirrored?

tables.name: task_artifact_versions
tables.description: Versioned per-task artifacts under data/<task-id>/, with a foreign key to the mirrored task id.
questions: Which per-task firstmate artifacts were mirrored?
